title: `type: 'form'` action fired from a record opens an empty CREATE form — `/forms/:name` ignores the `?recordId=` ActionRunner forwards
body:
Found while implementing #4109 (which touches the same route and the same submit path). Filed unassigned for triage; deliberately **not** fixed in that PR — it is a separate defect with a separate acceptance test, and #4109's scope is the shell nesting plus the post-submit default.

## What happens

`ActionRunner.executeForm` forwards the current record id to the internal form route:

`packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:1325-1329`
```ts
const recordId =
  (this.context.record && (this.context.record as { id?: unknown }).id) ??
  (this.context.data && (this.context.data as { id?: unknown }).id);
const base = `/forms/${name}`;
const to = recordId != null ? `${base}?recordId=${encodeURIComponent(String(recordId))}` : base;
```

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` never reads that param. The only query params it consumes are the `prefill_` ones, in `readPrefill`. So in internal mode the route:

1. loads the FormView metadata and renders **empty** inputs — the record's current values are never fetched;
2. submits through `submitInternal`, which is `POST /api/v1/data/:object` — an **INSERT**, unconditionally.

An "edit this record" action therefore renders a blank form and, on submit, creates a second record instead of updating the one the user was looking at.

## Reproduction (showcase)

`showcase_log_time` in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` is exactly this shape — `type: 'form'`, `target: 'showcase_task.edit'`, `locations: ['record_header', 'record_related', 'record_section']`. Open any Task, click **Log Time**, fill the form, Submit: a NEW task is created and the original is untouched.

## Why it is worth grading now

The forwarded `?recordId=` says the producer's intent is an edit, and the target view is literally named `edit`, so the metadata is not at fault — the renderer simply never implemented the read side. Until #4109 the outcome was invisible: the post-submit default was the anonymous `thank-you` panel, so the user saw "Your submission has been received" and no record. After #4109 an internal submit lands on the record it created, which means the duplicate becomes visible immediately (arguably an improvement — it surfaces the bug instead of hiding it — but it is still a duplicate).

## What a fix would need to decide

Not obvious enough to guess, which is part of why it is filed rather than fixed:

- whether `recordId` should make the route load the record and switch the submit to `PATCH /api/v1/data/:object/:id`, or whether internal `type: 'form'` should route to the existing app-shell record-form surface instead of this standalone renderer;
- what the route should do when `recordId` names a record the user cannot read, or one belonging to a different object than the view's target;
- whether `recordId` deserves a place in `app-shell/src/urlParams.ts` (it is adjacent to the reserved `recordId` drawer param already registered there, and the collision is worth ruling on explicitly).

## Measured on

`origin/main` at `4cb0562b5`, by reading the two files above; not browser-verified.
